title: The Impact of Detector Architecture, Model Scale, and Scene Density on Multi-Pedestrian Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.19369v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pedestrian tracking in video is important for applications such as surveillance and scene analysis, but it becomes more challenging in crowded scenarios with frequent occlusions and rapid motion. This paper analyzes how detector architecture, model scale, scene density, and inference regime affect the tracking of multiple pedestrians. We compare the YOLO11, RT-DETR, and YOLO26 detector families with the ByteTrack and BoT-SORT trackers on sequences from the MOT17, MOT20, and SOMPT22 benchmarks. For YOLO26, we also compare traditional overlap filtering via Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) with end-to-end inference. The RT-DETR family achieved the highest mean scores on the HOTA tracking quality metric across all three benchmarks with both trackers, with a more pronounced advantage on MOT20, albeit at a higher computational cost. translated_title: 检测器架构、模型规模与场景密度对多行人跟踪的影响
translated_abstract: 视频中的行人跟踪对于监控和场景分析等应用非常重要，但在遮挡频繁、运动快速的拥挤场景中变得更具挑战性。本文分析了检测器架构、模型规模、场景密度和推理方式如何影响多行人跟踪。我们在MOT17、MOT20和SOMPT22基准数据集的视频序列上，将YOLO11、RT-DETR和YOLO26检测器家族分别与ByteTrack和BoT-SORT跟踪器进行了组合比较。对于YOLO26，我们还比较了基于非极大值抑制（NMS）的传统重叠过滤方式与端到端推理方式。结果表明，RT-DETR检测器家族在所有三个基准上与两种跟踪器结合时，在HOTA跟踪质量指标上均取得了最高的平均分数，且在MOT20上优势更为明显，但其计算成本也更高。在MOT17和SOMPT22上，YOLO26变体，尤其是使用NMS的YOLO26-L，在跟踪质量与效率之间提供了有利的组合。
tldr: 本研究系统评估了检测器架构、模型规模、场景密度和推理方式对多行人跟踪的影响，发现RT-DETR在跟踪质量上表现最佳（尤其在拥挤的MOT20场景），而YOLO26-L配合NMS在质量与效率之间达到最佳平衡。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates how detector architecture, model scale, scene density, and inference regime affect multi-pedestrian tracking, finding that RT-DETR achieves the highest tracking quality (especially on crowded MOT20 scenes), while YOLO26-L with NMS offers the best quality-efficiency trade-off.
